test_f_gold: test the f_gold function to verify two arrays can be permuted so every pair sum is greater than or equal to k
run_f_gold: run f_gold with two arrays, a count n, and threshold k to check if all paired sums meet the threshold
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating input arrays by using sorted copies instead of in-place sort
review_f_gold: review f_gold which sorts one array descending and the other ascending to validate all pair sums against k
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that checks if two arrays can be permuted so every element pair sums to at least k
